findings.text: tests/test_a_held_lane_never_holds_a_review.py:79 asserts that named_route.set_by equals REVIEW_FOLLOWS_RUN, the same variable the test passed into _dispatch(lane_origin=...) two lines earlier at :76, so the two sides move together; it does fail if dispatch stops echoing lane_origin, but it cannot independently establish the recorded value and is not the guard the rebind rests on (that is :85-:90, shown red by the negative control).

The source node's done_when asks that test files importing reckon.crew.queue_admission or reckon.crew.recovery_review_dispatch add no failure against the base, but the recorded gate ran one such neighbour (tests/test_route_before_queue.py) plus the new file; 98 test files import the two touched modules and no arm over that population is recorded in manifest.md or gates/. Regression breadth across the touched modules is therefore claimed rather than measured.

reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:2971 gates the new origin on record.get('subject') != 'plan' so a plan review's configured lane stays authoritative, but no added test exercises the plan-review side; removing that condition would silently make plan reviews' configured lanes rebindable and the suite would stay green.

VERDICT done_when: the done_when's three cases are all asserted by tests/test_a_held_lane_never_holds_a_review.py:74-90, :93-106 and :114-137; its regression clause over the test files importing the two touched modules is not run (98 files, one neighbour measured) and its ruff clause is recorded in manifest.md:24.
VERDICT write_paths: the seven declared paths are reckon/crew/queue_admission.py, reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py, reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py, reckon/crew/dispatch.py, tests/test_a_held_lane_never_holds_a_review.py and the evidence fragment plus figures directory; every path in the diff is among them and recovery_review_subject.py and the figures directory are untouched.

JUSTIFICATION evidence: gates/after.log records 15 passed / EXIT=0 at 140f189d and gates/negative_control.log records 1 failed / EXIT=1, but the done_when's clause over the 98 test files importing reckon/crew/queue_admission.py or reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py is measured over one neighbour file only.

JUSTIFICATION durability: tests/test_a_held_lane_never_holds_a_review.py:85 re-implements the removed guard by reddening when _local_fallback returns None (shown as EXIT=1 under the negative control), but :79 echoes the input it passed in and the plan-review exclusion at recovery_review_dispatch.py:2971 is untested.
